quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Every weekday, Mira takes a fifteen-minute walk after lunch to clear her mind before returning to work. On weekends, she prefers to sleep in and skip the walk entirely.
quests.question: Mira takes her walk on weekends too.
quests.hint: Check what Mira does differently on weekends.
quests.explanation: The passage says she skips the walk on weekends, so this statement is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: After years of putting it off, Josef finally enrolled in a part-time college course to finish the degree he started long ago. He attends classes two evenings a week while continuing to work full time.
quests.question: Josef attends classes two evenings a week.
quests.hint: Check how often Josef attends class each week.
quests.explanation: The passage states he attends two evenings a week, so this matches exactly.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Since being promoted last spring, Delia has managed a team of six people across two departments. She still handles some of her old responsibilities alongside her new ones.
quests.question: Delia manages a team of six people.
quests.hint: Look at the size of Delia's team.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms she manages a team of six, so this statement is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Because the airline canceled his original flight, Ahmed was rebooked on a later flight with a two-hour layover in a different city. He arrived at his final destination almost four hours behind schedule.
quests.question: Ahmed arrived earlier than originally planned.
quests.hint: Check how Ahmed's arrival time compared to the original plan.
quests.explanation: The passage says he arrived four hours late, so arriving earlier is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Although Imani and her husband both grew up in large families, they have decided to raise their own two children in a quieter household. They still gather with extended family for major holidays each year.
quests.question: Imani and her husband have three children.
quests.hint: Count how many children are mentioned.
quests.explanation: The passage says they have two children, not three, so this is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Instead of buying furniture new, Priya has started shopping at secondhand stores to save money and reduce waste. Last month, she found a dining table that was barely used for a fraction of the original price.
quests.question: Priya found a dining table at a secondhand store.
quests.hint: Check where Priya found the dining table.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms she found it at a secondhand store, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Although Elif rarely baked before moving into her own apartment, she has started making bread from scratch every weekend. Her neighbors have started requesting a loaf whenever they smell it baking.
quests.question: Elif has been baking bread for many years.
quests.hint: Check how long Elif has actually been baking.
quests.explanation: The passage says she rarely baked before recently, so many years is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: After her smart watch stopped syncing with her phone, Layla spent almost an hour trying to fix the connection herself before contacting support. A quick software update ultimately solved the problem.
quests.question: Layla fixed the issue by buying a new watch.
quests.hint: Check what actually solved Layla's problem.
quests.explanation: The passage says a software update solved it, not a new watch, so this is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Since switching to a standing desk six months ago, Felix has noticed less pain in his lower back by the end of the workday. He still sits for meetings but stands for most of his individual tasks.
quests.question: Felix sits for all of his work tasks.
quests.hint: Check when Felix actually sits versus stands.
quests.explanation: The passage says he stands for most tasks and only sits for meetings, so this is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Instead of watching the championship game live, Yusuf recorded it and watched it later that night to avoid spoilers on social media. He says the strategy worked, though it required avoiding his phone all afternoon.
quests.question: Yusuf watched the game live as it happened.
quests.hint: Check when Yusuf actually watched the game.
quests.explanation: The passage says he watched a recording later, not live, so this is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Although camels are often associated with deserts, they can also survive in cold, mountainous regions with proper adaptation. Their bodies are well suited to extreme temperatures in both directions.
quests.question: Camels can only survive in hot desert climates.
quests.hint: Check what other climate camels can survive in.
quests.explanation: The passage says they can also survive in cold regions, so only hot deserts is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: After a two-year renovation, the old train station downtown reopened last month as a public market with food stalls and craft vendors. Local officials say it has already attracted more visitors than expected.
quests.question: The train station reopened as a public market.
quests.hint: Check what the train station became after renovation.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms it reopened as a public market, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Before he learned to cook, Tobias used to order takeout almost every night. Now he cooks at home five nights a week and only orders takeout on Fridays.
quests.question: Tobias now cooks at home most nights of the week.
quests.hint: Check how many nights Tobias now cooks at home.
quests.explanation: The passage says he cooks five nights a week, which is most nights, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: The community college added an evening schedule specifically for working adults last semester. Since then, enrollment among students over thirty has nearly doubled.
quests.question: Enrollment among older students has decreased since the change.
quests.hint: Check how enrollment has changed since the new schedule.
quests.explanation: The passage says enrollment nearly doubled, so a decrease is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: When the company switched to a four-day work week last year, most employees reported feeling less stressed. A small number, however, said they now feel more pressure to finish tasks faster.
quests.question: Every single employee reported feeling less stressed after the change.
quests.hint: Check whether the passage says all employees felt the same way.
quests.explanation: The passage says a small number felt more pressure, so not every employee felt less stressed.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Instead of driving the entire distance in one day, Petra and her husband decided to split their road trip across two days and stay overnight at a small inn. The extra day allowed them to visit a nearby waterfall.
quests.question: Petra and her husband stopped overnight during their road trip.
quests.hint: Check what Petra and her husband did during the trip.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms they stayed overnight at an inn, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Since retiring last year, Hank has taken over most of the cooking at home, something his wife used to handle for over thirty years. She says she has enjoyed the break from the kitchen.
quests.question: Hank's wife now does most of the cooking.
quests.hint: Check who now handles most of the cooking.
quests.explanation: The passage says Hank took over the cooking, not his wife, so this is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: The store's loyalty program gives customers a discount after their tenth purchase, but only if the account has been active for at least three months. Otherwise, the discount does not apply.
quests.question: The discount applies regardless of how long the account has been active.
quests.hint: Check the condition about how long the account must be active.
quests.explanation: The passage says the account must be active for three months, so it does not apply regardless.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: The restaurant switched to a seasonal menu last year, changing its dishes every three months instead of once a year. Regular customers say they now look forward to trying something new more often.
quests.question: The restaurant now changes its menu every three months.
quests.hint: Check how often the menu changes now.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms the menu changes every three months, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: After discovering a flaw in its messaging app, the company released a security update. Users who had not updated their app within a week received a warning notification.
quests.question: The security update followed the discovery of a flaw.
quests.hint: Check what caused the company to release the update.
quests.explanation: The passage says the update followed the discovery of a flaw, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: The evening appointment slots are rarely booked.
quests.hint: Check how full the evening slots usually are.
quests.explanation: The passage says they are almost always fully booked, so rarely booked is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: Ticket sales for the Sunday matinee have grown each week.
quests.hint: Check how ticket sales have changed over time.
quests.explanation: The passage says sales have grown steadily each week, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Certain species of trees can communicate with each other through underground fungal networks, sending warning signals when insects attack. Scientists have only recently begun to understand how extensive these networks really are.
quests.question: Trees can send warning signals through underground fungal networks.

quests.explanation: The passage directly describes this process, so the statement is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.explanation: The passage says the program expanded, so a reduction is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Ever since adopting a new puppy, Clara wakes up an hour earlier than she used to. She now takes the puppy for a short walk before getting ready for work.
quests.question: Clara wakes up later than she used to.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: Renee meets with a tutor on a weekly basis.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: After struggling to find childcare, Tomas negotiated a flexible schedule that lets him start work an hour later on Tuesdays and Thursdays. His manager approved the arrangement for a three-month trial period.
quests.question: Tomas starts later on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
quests.hint: Check which days Tomas starts work later.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: The ferry runs the same number of times year-round.
quests.hint: Compare the ferry schedule in summer and winter.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: When her older brother moved out for college, Talia suddenly had the bedroom to herself for the first time. She admits she still calls him most evenings because she misses having him around.
quests.question: Talia calls her brother most evenings.
quests.hint: Check how often Talia calls her brother now.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms she calls him most evenings, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Because the item she wanted was more expensive in stores, Nadia decided to wait for an online sale instead of buying it right away. She ended up saving almost thirty percent by waiting two weeks.
quests.question: Nadia saved money by waiting for an online sale.
quests.hint: Check what happened after Nadia waited two weeks.
